task.title: GitHub’dagi portfolio va birovning repozitoriysi
task.description:
Siz ~/portfolio papkasida, main tarmog‘idasiz, tarixda 3 ta kommit bor. «GitHub»da bo‘sh https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git repozitoriysi yaratilgan, kursdoshingiz Azizda esa Git bo‘yicha konspektli https://github.com/aziz/notes.git repozitoriysi bor. Buyruqlarni har bir qatorga bittadan yozing: 1) https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git masofaviy repozitoriysini origin nomi bilan ulang va masofaviy repozitoriylar ro‘yxatini tekshiring (git remote -v). 2) main tarmog‘ini GitHub’ga shunday yuboringki, origin/main uning upstream’i bo‘lsin. 3) git status ni bajaring va tarmoq up to date with 'origin/main' ekaniga ishonch hosil qiling. 4) feature/about tarmog‘ini yarating va unga o‘ting,

About me

matnli about.html faylini yarating va uni kommit qiling. 5) feature/about tarmog‘ini origin/feature/about upstream’i bilan GitHub’ga yuboring. 6) Uy papkasiga qayting va https://github.com/aziz/notes.git ni klonlang. 7) notes papkasiga o‘ting, tarixni (git log --oneline) va masofaviy repozitoriylarni ko‘ring. Natijada serverdagi main tarixi siznikiga mos keladi, serverda main va feature/about tarmoqlari bor, ikkala tarmoqda upstream sozlangan, ~/notes da esa Aziz repozitoriysining butun tarixi bilan nusxasi turibdi.
task.starter_code:
# Buyruqlarni har bir qatorga bittadan yozing. # bilan boshlangan qatorlar - izohlar. # Siz ~/portfolio papkasida, main tarmog‘idasiz, tarixda 3 ta kommit bor. # GitHub’da bo‘sh https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git repozitoriysi yaratilgan # 1. Masofaviy repozitoriyni origin nomi bilan ulang va masofaviylar ro‘yxatini tekshiring # 2. main ni GitHub’ga yuboring va origin/main ni uning upstream’i qiling # 3. git status ni tekshiring: tarmoq up to date with 'origin/main' bo‘lishi kerak # 4. feature/about tarmog‘i,

About me

bilan about.html fayli, kommit # 5. feature/about ni upstream bilan GitHub’ga yuboring # 6. Uy papkasiga qayting va https://github.com/aziz/notes.git ni klonlang # 7. notes ga o‘ting va tarixni ko‘ring

tests.name: ~/portfolio da anna/portfolio repozitoriysi manzili bilan origin ulangan
tests.fail: Masofaviy repozitoriyni ulang: git remote add origin https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git (nomi - origin, manzil - xatosiz). git remote -v ni tekshiring.

tests.name: «GitHub»da aynan ikkita tarmoq: feature/about va main
tests.fail: Ikkala tarmoqni yuboring: git push -u origin main va feature/about da turib git push -u origin feature/about.

tests.name: Serverdagi main tarixi lokal tarix bilan mos (barcha kommitlar, o‘sha xeshlar)
tests.fail: Serverdagi main xuddi sizdagidek bo‘lishi kerak. push’dan keyin main da kommit qilmang, about.html ni esa feature/about tarmog‘ida kommit qiling.

tests.name: main o‘zgarmagan: 3 ta boshlang‘ich kommit, about.html unga tushmagan
tests.check: sim.repo("~/portfolio").log("main").map((c) => c.subject).join("|") === "Add job title|Add styles|Add home page"
tests.fail: about.html sahifasi bilan kommit feature/about tarmog‘ida bo‘lishi kerak: kommitdan oldin uni git switch -c feature/about buyrug‘i bilan yarating.

tests.name: feature/about: main ustida about.html bilan bitta kommit, serverda - o‘sha kommit
tests.check:
(() => { const c = sim.repo("~/portfolio").commit("feature/about"); return c !== null && c.parents[0] === sim.repo("~/portfolio").tip("main") && typeof c.files["about.html"] === "string" && c.files["about.html"].includes("

About me

") && sim.remote("https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git").tip("feature/about") !== null && sim.remote("https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git").tip("feature/about") === sim.repo("~/portfolio").tip("feature/about"); })()
tests.fail: feature/about da yangi about.html fayli bilan bitta kommit bo‘lishi (git add about.html ni unutmang) va u serverga yuborilgan bo‘lishi kerak.

tests.name: main ning upstream’i - origin/main
tests.fail: main ni birinchi marta -u kaliti bilan yuboring: git push -u origin main. -u siz tarmoq qayerga yuborilishini eslab qolmaydi.

tests.name: feature/about ning upstream’i - origin/feature/about
tests.fail: Yangi tarmoqni ham -u bilan yuboring: git push -u origin feature/about. Shunchaki git push has no upstream branch deb javob beradi.

tests.name: ~/portfolio da hamma narsa kommit qilingan
tests.fail: about.html fayli feature/about tarmog‘idagi kommitda bo‘lishi kerak: git add about.html, keyin git commit -m.

tests.name: Yuborishdan keyin git status up to date with 'origin/main' ni ko‘rsatdi
tests.check: __commands.some((c) => c.cmd.startsWith("git status") && c.out.includes("Your branch is up to date with 'origin/main'"))
tests.fail: git push -u origin main dan keyin darhol git status ni bajaring - Git tarmoq origin/main bilan bir xil ekanini aytadi.

tests.name: Masofaviy repozitoriylar ro‘yxati tekshirildi: git remote -v
tests.fail: git remote add dan keyin natijani ko‘ring: git remote -v (repozitoriy ichida).

tests.name: aziz/notes repozitoriysi ~/notes ga klonlangan: aziz tarixi va origin
tests.check: sim.repo("~/notes") !== null && sim.repo("~/notes").root === "/home/student/notes" && sim.repo("~/notes").remotes().origin === "https://github.com/aziz/notes.git" && JSON.stringify(sim.repo("~/notes").log().map((c) => c.hash)) === JSON.stringify(sim.remote("https://github.com/aziz/notes.git").log("main").map((c) => c.hash)) && sim.repo("~/notes").log().every((c) => c.author === "Aziz Rakhimov")
tests.fail: Uy papkasiga qayting (cd ~) va git clone https://github.com/aziz/notes.git ni bajaring - ~/notes papkasi paydo bo‘ladi. portfolio ichida klonlash shart emas.

tests.name: Klonlangan repozitoriy tarixi ko‘rildi
tests.check: __commands.some((c) => c.cmd.startsWith("git log") && c.out.includes("Add git commands") && c.out.includes("Add README"))
tests.fail: notes papkasiga o‘ting (cd notes) va tarixni ko‘ring: git log --oneline.

tests.name: Boshqa lokal tarix (5 ta kommit): server unga mos, upstream’lar sozlangan
tests.check: JSON.stringify(sim.remote("https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git").log("main").map((c) => c.hash)) === JSON.stringify(sim.repo("~/portfolio").log("main").map((c) => c.hash)) && sim.repo("~/portfolio").log("main").length === 5 && sim.remote("https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git").tip("feature/about") !== null && sim.remote("https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git").tip("feature/about") === sim.repo("~/portfolio").tip("feature/about") && sim.repo("~/portfolio").commit("feature/about").parents[0] === sim.repo("~/portfolio").tip("main") && sim.remote("https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git").branches().join(",") === "feature/about,main" && sim.repo("~/portfolio").upstream("main") === "origin/main" && sim.repo("~/portfolio").upstream("feature/about") === "origin/feature/about" && sim.repo("~/notes") !== null && sim.repo("~/notes").root === "/home/student/notes" && sim.repo("~/notes").remotes().origin === "https://github.com/aziz/notes.git" && JSON.stringify(sim.repo("~/notes").log().map((c) => c.hash)) === JSON.stringify(sim.remote("https://github.com/aziz/notes.git").log("main").map((c) => c.hash)) && sim.repo("~/notes").log().every((c) => c.author === "Aziz Rakhimov")
tests.fail: Yechim istalgan tarix uchun ishlashi kerak: sizdagi main ni yuboring va main da kommit yaratmang.

hints: Masofaviy repozitoriyni ulash: git remote add origin https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git. Tekshirish: git remote -v.
Tarmoqni birinchi yuborish - -u kaliti bilan: git push -u origin main. Git branch 'main' set up to track 'origin/main' deb javob beradi.
Yangi tarmoqni yaratib, unga bitta buyruq bilan o‘ting: git switch -c feature/about. Kommitdan oldin yangi fayl uchun - git add about.html.
feature/about tarmog‘ini ham -u bilan yuboring: git push -u origin feature/about. Shunchaki git push has no upstream branch deb javob beradi.
Klonlash loyiha papkasidan emas, uy papkasidan bajariladi: cd ~, keyin git clone https://github.com/aziz/notes.git. Git notes papkasini yaratadi - unga o‘ting (cd notes).

questions.question: Masofaviy repozitoriy (remote) nima?
options: O‘chirilgan va tiklash mumkin bo‘lgan repozitoriy
Repozitoriyning boshqa kompyuter yoki serverdagi, masalan GitHub’dagi nusxasi
questions.explanation: Remote - loyihaning o‘sha tarixi, faqat boshqa joyda: GitHub’da, kompaniya serverida, hamkasbning kompyuterida. Git u bilan push, fetch, pull buyruqlari orqali kommit almashadi.

questions.question:
Git nima chiqardi?

$ git remote -v
origin	https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git (fetch)
origin	https://github.com/anna/portfolio.git (push)
options: Bitta origin masofaviy repozitoriysi ulangan, undan ham yuklab olinadi, unga ham yuboriladi
questions.explanation: Ikki marta ko‘rsatilgan bitta origin yozuvi: yuklab olish (fetch) va yuborish (push) manzili. Odatda ular bir xil.

questions.question: Buyruqni to‘liq kiriting: main tarmog‘ini origin ga yuborish va origin/main ni uning upstream’i qilish (qisqa kalit).
questions.explanation: -u (--set-upstream) main ↔ origin/main bog‘lanishini eslab qoladi. Keyin shunchaki git push va git pull yozish kifoya.

questions.question:
Git nima chiqardi?

$ git push
fatal: The current branch feature/about has no upstream branch.
options: Tarmoq hali bir marta ham -u bilan yuborilmagan: Git uni qayerga yuborishni bilmaydi
questions.explanation: Remote ulangan, lekin tarmoqning upstream’i yo‘q. Yechimni Git o‘zi aytadi: git push --set-upstream origin feature/about (yoki git push -u origin feature/about).

questions.question: Git xabarini va sababini moslang.
pairs: error: src refspec master does not match any
Manzilda xato yoki repozitoriyga kirish huquqi yo‘q
Token o‘rniga akkaunt paroli kiritilgan yoki token noto‘g‘ri
questions.explanation: Xatoning birinchi qatorini o‘qing: u deyarli har doim muammoni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytadi.

questions.question: Repozitoriyingizdagi origin/main nimani ko‘rsatadi?
options: GitHub’dagi main tarmog‘ining aynan shu soniyadagi holatini
Git’ingizga ma’lum bo‘lgan serverdagi main ning oxirgi holatini - oxirgi push, fetch yoki pull paytidagi
questions.explanation: origin/main - serverning «surati». U faqat server bilan almashishda yangilanadi. Hamkasbingiz kommit yuborsa, uni origin/main da faqat git fetch dan keyin ko‘rasiz.

questions.question: HTTPS yoki SSH orqali git push qilishda GitHub’ga nima bilan kirish mumkin?
options: Ochiq qismi GitHub sozlamalariga qo‘shilgan SSH kaliti
questions.explanation: GitHub 2021-yildan beri Git amallari uchun akkaunt parolini qabul qilmaydi. Token, Git Credential Manager yoki gh auth login orqali kirish, yoki SSH kaliti kerak.

questions.question: git fetch git pull dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
options: fetch yangi kommitlarni yuklab oladi va origin/main ni yangilaydi, lekin fayllaringizga tegmaydi; pull = fetch + joriy tarmoqqa birlashtirish
fetch kommitlarni yuboradi, pull yuklab oladi
questions.explanation: fetch xavfsiz: faqat «nima yangilik borligini ko‘rish». pull esa o‘zgarishlarni darhol tarmog‘ingiz va ishchi papkangizga birlashtiradi.

questions.question:
Git nima chiqardi?

$ git status
On branch main
Your branch is behind 'origin/main' by 1 commit, and can be fast-forwarded.
  (use "git pull" to update your local branch)
options: Serverda main ingizda yo‘q 1 ta kommit bor; git pull uni oldinga o‘tkazadi
questions.explanation: behind - «orqada». Bu xabar git fetch dan keyin, serverda yangi kommitlar paydo bo‘lganda chiqadi. ahead buning teskarisini bildirardi - sizda yuborilmagan kommitlar bor.

questions.question: Sizda kommitlari bor lokal loyiha allaqachon mavjud. Siz u uchun GitHub’da repozitoriy yaratyapsiz. Nima to‘g‘ri?
options: Repozitoriyni bo‘sh yaratgan ma’qul: README, .gitignore va litsenziyasiz
«Add README» ni albatta belgilash kerak, aks holda push ishlamaydi
Yaratilgandan keyin GitHub git remote add uchun kerakli manzilni ko‘rsatadi
Yopiq repozitoriyni faqat siz va siz taklif qilganlar ko‘radi
questions.explanation: Agar GitHub README bilan o‘zining birinchi kommitini yaratsa, serverda va sizda ikki xil tarix bo‘ladi va birinchi push rad etiladi. Bo‘sh repozitoriy tarixingizni to‘liq qabul qiladi.

questions.question: Buyruqni va u nima qilishini moslang.
pairs: Repozitoriyni to‘liq yangi papkaga yuklab olish va origin ni ulash
Yangi kommitlarni yuklab olish, origin/* ni yangilash, fayllarga tegmaslik
Yuklab olish va darhol joriy tarmoqqa birlashtirish
questions.explanation: clone - boshida bir marta; fetch va pull - boshqalarnikini olish; push - o‘zingiznikini berish.

questions.question: Buyruqni to‘liq kiriting: zamonaviy ed25519 turidagi SSH kalitini yaratish (-C kalitisiz).
questions.explanation: ssh-keygen juftlik yaratadi: yopiq kalit ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 (hech kimga ko‘rsatmang) va ochiq ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub - uni GitHub sozlamalariga qo‘shishadi.
